scope: Close the existing 7AE locale readiness gap with a generated legacy DXF import/export/re-import control under a Turkish C locale; audit file-extension case handling without duplicating its existing test.

control.operation: import -> export AC1018 -> inspect wire bytes/header -> re-import

pathSuffixAudit.implementation: ASCII-only folding of a-z in dx_iface::fileImport
covers: non-ASCII suffix refusal before DXF/DWG reader invocation

limits: A host without one of the recognized Turkish locale names reports SKIP for this optional focused control.
The filename test does not qualify unrelated Unicode path or symbol-name normalization.
No DWG support, independent peer result, native CAD result, or external-J item is promoted.
